name: agent-eval
description: Domain-agnostic evaluation platform for voice / tool-calling agents.

scripts.test: tsx platform/src/judge.test.ts && tsx platform/src/match.test.ts && tsx demo/adapters/dental/score.test.ts && tsx platform/src/engine.test.ts
scripts.eval:real:dental: tsx demo/gen-audio.ts --adapter dental && tsx platform/src/cli.ts run --adapter dental --provider openai --stt openai --prompt demo/prompts/dental-good.txt --name dental-real
scripts.eval:real:dental:weak: tsx platform/src/cli.ts run --adapter dental --provider openai --stt openai --prompt demo/prompts/dental-weak.txt --name dental-real
scripts.eval:real:receptionist: tsx demo/gen-audio.ts --adapter receptionist && tsx platform/src/cli.ts run --adapter receptionist --provider openai --stt openai --prompt demo/prompts/receptionist-good.txt --name receptionist-real
scripts.eval:real:receptionist:weak: tsx platform/src/cli.ts run --adapter receptionist --provider openai --stt openai --prompt demo/prompts/receptionist-weak.txt --name receptionist-real
